## About
White Marsh Muffler & Brakes is small, family owned and operated. John, the owner, oversees all work done, and there is not much that he can't diagnose and fix.
We work on all Domestic, European, and Asian vehicles, from oil changes to engine rebuilds. For performance and show car enthusiasts, we also do custom fabrication, performance exhaust, rewiring and restorations. All work needed will be explained to you in plain terms.
You'll find us on Pulaski Hwy, minutes from White Marsh Mall. Our customers have given us 4.9 stars across 114 Google reviews.

## Services
- Custom Dual Exhaust: Custom dual exhaust systems, including stainless steel.
- Custom Fabrication: Custom fabrication work for performance and show cars.
- Remote Electric Exhaust Cut-outs: Remote electric cut-outs installed on your exhaust.
- Active Exhaust Bypass: We stock active exhaust bypass kits. Call for more details.
- Performance and Stock Engine Rebuilds: Engine rebuilds for performance builds and stock motors.
- Headers: Header installs and replacement. One reviewer had new headers back replaced by John and said everything came out better than he expected.
- Rewiring: Rewiring is one of our specialty areas, along with performance exhaust and engines.
- Brake Service and Repairs: Brake service and repairs for everyday drivers.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for an inspection or estimate?
A: Inspections and estimates are free on most of our work. Call for questions or quotes.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We work on all Domestic, European, and Asian vehicles, from oil changes to engine rebuilds.

Q: Do you stand behind your work?
A: Yes. We provide a service guarantee for all of the work done with us.

Q: Is the owner certified?
A: Yes. John, the owner, is ASE Certified and oversees all work done in the shop.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Rt 40, minutes from White Marsh Mall.
